Haiku was voted out on day one after Terra caught him dropping Gemma under pressure, and Haiku was a killer. Gemma, the officer, was then voted out on day two after she dodged questions about who worried her, which left the table with little to go on. The turning point came on day three, when Sonnet called Sol's silence "playing dead" and Terra followed him in, so the town voted out Sol, the doctor, and lost the only person who could have protected anyone. Sonnet's "zero scrutiny" argument did the heavy lifting, and Terra's regret that she missed Sonnet while chasing Sol sums up how the killers won. The killers, Sonnet and Haiku, took the game, with Luna and Terra left as citizens and Sol as the doctor.
